regime_context: Detector shows a defensive/narrowing rotation: Big Pharma is the headline (eligible, high durability 0.84, crowded), but the top momentum rank is ineligible Memory/HBM. Only 19 of 49 themes are trend-eligible and breadth of rotation is narrowing, consistent with the validated absolute-trend gate favouring downside control over return forecasting. Macro backdrop is AI-tech/geopolitics heavy with unscheduled share 1.0, so headlines are coincident noise rather than a trigger; track record dir_accuracy is weak (0.413), so conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the narrowing rotation (eligible frac 0.39) starts confirming a leadership handoff away from defensive health/pharma toward a previously ineligible AI-semiconductor cluster; the observable condition that would retire this watch is Memory, HBM & Storage (or AI Infrastructure) flipping eligible=true with breadth above 0.5 for five consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the only headline theme that is simultaneously eligible, trend-tagged, with high durability (0.84) and full breadth (1.0). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg and it is confirming here, which supports staying power over return prediction. Crowding (z=1.46) is a size-down caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: PPH is heavily concentrated in a handful of mega-cap drug names and is crowded (z=1.46); a single policy or litigation headline can hit the whole proxy hard, and rank-IC is ~0 so the leadership signal itself has no directional edge.

falsifier.text: PPH breaks below its own 63-day low or lags XLV by more than 8% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW is eligible, trend-tagged, with high durability (0.78) and strong breadth (0.917). It offers the same defensive trend exposure as Big Pharma but with less single-name concentration risk, and the absolute-trend gate is validating the theme's staying power.
theses.dissent: XLV's equal-weight construction still skews toward large health insurers and pharma; crowding (z=1.54) is among the highest in the panel, so the trade may already be well owned and any defensive unwind would hit it harder.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks below its 63-day low while the S&P 500 holds above its own 63-day low before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Despite ranking #1 on momentum score, Memory/HBM is ineligible (trend gate not confirming) with low durability (0.35) and zero breadth (0.0). The validated trend discipline says this leadership is not yet tradeable; the absolute-trend gate has not cleared, so avoiding it is consistent with the one leg that actually controls drawdown.
theses.dissent: AI memory/HBM has the strongest underlying fundamental narrative (AI capex, HBM supply tightness), and a sharp mean-reversion upward off a consolidating base could leave an avoid read early.

falsifier.text: SMH reclaims and holds above its 200-day moving average AND Memory/HBM flips eligible=true before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
